title: Royalty-Split Config Validator
description: Validates on-chain royalty split configurations for ERC-2981 (single-receiver) and 0xSplits-style (multi-recipient) protocols. Checks: sum equals 10000 basis points, no per-recipient cap breach, no duplicate or blank addresses, valid Ethereum address format, valid range per entry. Auto-detects bps vs percent mode. Exports an AINumbers Policy Mandate on valid configs.

entries.description: Array of recipient objects, each with 'address' and one of 'basis_points'/'bps'/'shares' (0–10000) or 'percent' (0–100)

cap_bps.description: Maximum basis points allowed per recipient (default 5000 = 50%)
